title: Euro advances against Japanese Yen despite BoJ rate hike expectations
summary: EUR/JPY edges higher on Monday and trades around 178.40 at the time of writing, up 0.12% on the day. The pair remains supported despite growing expectations of further monetary tightening by the Bank of Japan (BoJ), while the European Central Bank (ECB) policy outlook remains uncertain.

title: Japanese Yen weakens as rising risk aversion lifts US Dollar
summary: USD/JPY rebounds after posting modest losses the previous day, trading around 154.60 during European hours on Monday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains amid rising oil prices and growing Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike bets.

title: Euro: Further downside favoured against US Dollar - ING
summary: ING’s Francesco Pesole highlights that EUR/USD has broken below 1.1600, with the bank maintaining a downside bias consistent with its constructive Dollar view.
